name: export
description: Export a generated Evie enclosure solid to STEP, STL, or IGES and return path + bytes. Dogfood artifact only — present the path for approve/revise, do not treat as product print-GO.

inline_spec.description: Optional YAML/JSON spec used when generating a new solid because artifact_id is omitted.

dest.description: Optional output path. Directory is created if needed.

token.description: Bot token. Default stub is local-dogfood (or COPILOTCAD_BOT_TOKEN).
